$comment: Receipts for every number the viewer displays. Each entry carries the verbatim sentence from the technical report it came from; verify.py enforces that index.html still matches. Numbers the report does not publish are listed under removed_claims and must stay out.

source.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: Pushing the Limits of KV Cache Compression
source.how_to_recheck: curl -sL -o /tmp/ds41.pdf '<url>' && sha256sum /tmp/ds41.pdf && pdftotext -layout /tmp/ds41.pdf - | grep -i '<quote from this file>'

baseline_source.title: Attention Is All You Need
baseline_source.note: Left tower only: 6+6 layers, d_model 512, 8 heads, d_ff 2048, 65M base / 213M big. The 36 KB/token baseline and the ~41x gap are this project's own arithmetic, not paper numbers, and the UI labels them as such.

claims.claim: Decoder global KV is projected from the final encoder hidden states (H_{L/2}).

source.quote: We adopt a Causal Encoder-Decoder (CED) architecture, in which decoder global KV is projected from the final encoder hidden states.

must_contain: 解码器全局 KV 由编码器最后隐状态投影

claims.claim: CED computes only the first half of the layers during prefill.

source.quote: This design allows CED to compute only the first half of the layers during the prefill phase

claims.claim: 552B backbone parameters.

source.quote: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash has 552B backbone parameters

claims.claim: 8B activated per token in prefill, 16B in decode.

source.quote: This design enables the model to activate 8B parameters per token during prefill and 16B during decode

claims.claim: Global KV cache = 890 bytes per token in FP4, ~1/4 of V4-Flash.

source.quote: reduce its global KV cache footprint (always in HBM) to 890 bytes per token, roughly 1/4 of the corresponding footprint of DeepSeek-V4-Flash

claims.claim: Persistent KV cache ~1/8 of V4-Flash via SWA Bounded Replay.

source.quote: reduces its persistent KV cache footprint (always on SSD or in host memory) to roughly 1/8 of that of DeepSeek-V4-Flash

claims.claim: ~437x smaller per-token global KV than DeepSeek-V1.

source.quote: achieves approximately 4-fold and 437-fold reductions in per-token global KV cache size relative to DeepSeek-V4-Flash and DeepSeek-V1

claims.claim: MXFP4 E2M1 with one E4M3 scale per 16 channels.

source.quote: we select E2M1 with one E4M3 scale per 16 channels

must_contain: 每 16 通道一个 E4M3 scale

claims.claim: The cache is quantized after RoPE.

source.quote: We quantize the cache after RoPE

claims.claim: SWA window n_win = 128 in every layer.

source.quote: the window size 𝑛win is set to 128

claims.claim: The first two layers use pure SWA.

source.quote: For the first two layers, we use pure sliding window attention.

claims.claim: Encoder CSA2: 3 groups of 6, first layer Full, next 5 Reuse (m=2).

source.quote: These layers are divided into three identically configured groups of six layers. In each group, the first layer operates in Full Mode, and the remaining five layers operate in Reuse Mode.

claims.claim: Decoder CSA2: 5 groups of 4, group 1 is Full + 3 Reuse (m=1).

source.quote: The 20 decoder layers use CSA2 with a compression rate of 𝑚 = 1. These layers are divided into five groups of four layers. In the first group, the first layer operates in Full Mode, and the remaining three layers operate in Reuse Mode.

claims.claim: Decoder groups 2-5 start with Reindex Mode.

source.quote: The remaining four groups share the same configuration: the first layer operates in Reindex Mode

claims.claim: Sparse attention reads Top-512 main KV entries per query.

source.quote: the number of KV entries selected for sparse attention (i.e., attention top-k) to 512

claims.claim: Candidate pool: 2048 blocks x 8 positions = 16,384 positions.

source.quote: selecting 2,048 blocks with 8 positions each yields 16,384 candidate positions

claims.claim: 64 query heads, head dim 512, query compression dim 1280.

source.quote: We set the number of query heads to 64, the head dimension to 512, and the query compression dimension to 1280.

claims.claim: Indexer: 32 query heads, head dim 128.

source.quote: we set the number of indexer query heads to 32, the indexer head dimension to 128

claims.claim: MoE: 1 shared + 384 routed experts, 6 active, expert dim 2304.

source.quote: Each MoE layer consists of 1 shared expert and 384 routed experts, where the intermediate hidden dimension of each expert is 2304. Among the routed experts, 6 experts will be activated for each token.

claims.claim: Single-Pass mHC: expansion factor 4, 20 Sinkhorn-Knopp iterations.

source.quote: As for mHC, the expansion factor is set to 4, and the number of Sinkhorn-Knopp iterations is set to 20.

claims.claim: Engram: 196B parameters in two modules.

source.quote: We allocate 196B Engram parameters evenly across two modules.

claims.claim: Engram modules sit at layers 1 and 14 (zero-indexed).

source.quote: The modules are placed at layers 1 and 14 (zero-indexed)

claims.claim: DSpark: 3 Transformer blocks, 5 draft positions per forward pass.

source.quote: The drafter comprises three Transformer blocks with a sliding attention window of 128 tokens. A single forward pass through these blocks computes base logits for five draft positions in parallel

claims.claim: DeepSeek-ViT: 32 layers, hidden 1024, 16 heads, patch 14.

source.quote: we set its number of layers to 32, the hidden dimension to 1024, the number of attention heads to 16, and the image patch size to 14

claims.claim: Images up to ~1344x1344 px via 3x3 pixel-unshuffle.

source.quote: supporting input resolutions up to approximately 1344 × 1344 pixels

claims.claim: Reasoning effort is continuously controllable, integer 1-100.

source.quote: Reasoning Effort:           {effort} (range 1–100; higher values request more

claims.claim: Trained on a multimodal corpus of 45T tokens.

source.quote: multimodal corpus comprising 45T tokens

claims.claim: Sparse attention trained from scratch at 64K, no dense warmup.

source.quote: Sparse attention is trained from scratch at a sequence length of 64K, without any dense attention warmup stages.

claims.claim: Sequence length extended to 1M at 34T tokens.

source.quote: extend the sequence length to 1M at 34T tokens

claims.claim: Numbers the report does not publish, which an earlier revision asserted; they must stay out.

removed_claims.status: removed - 2.4.3 specifies only the three blocks, the 128-token window and the five draft positions

removed_claims.status: removed - the paper has no pre-norm discussion; the viewer now states post-norm as Figure 1 shows
removed - the report never says which layers feed the drafter
removed - the report bounds image resolution at ~1344x1344 and context at 1M tokens
